meta.scope: International indicative references from public SECONDARY sources (mostly vendor blogs and summaries). No Slovak process benchmark was found.
meta.caveat: Verify primary sources (ASQ, IISE, Vorne/OEE.com) before publishing. Values differ by sector, definition and measurement method. Never present as an average of Slovak MSP.

oee_pct.definitionNote: OEE = availability x performance x quality. The 85 % figure comes from TPM (Nakajima, 1984), roughly 90 x 95 x 99. Sector-dependent; only a small share of plants reach it.

copq_pct_of_sales.definitionNote: IISE: manufacturing average about 15 % of sales, range 5-35 % by product complexity. ASQ's 15-20 % refers to total quality-related costs, not failure costs only. Visible items (scrap, warranty) are often only 20-30 % of the true cost. The below-5 % world-class value comes from a compilation without a primary source (low confidence).

sources.name: IISE - Measuring the cost of quality
Reliamag - Cost of poor quality (cites ASQ)

otd_pct.definitionNote: OTD = orders delivered on time / orders shipped. Measuring against goods issue instead of goods receipt overstates performance. OEM scorecards use a composite delivery-performance metric, not plain OTD. Aberdeen (2007) defined best-in-class as about 95 % (old).

schedule_adherence_pct.definitionNote: Thresholds published by software vendors, not measured averages. Definitions differ (schedule adherence vs attainment vs compliance). APQC holds benchmark data but it is not publicly accessible.

hr_skills.note: No reliable public benchmark found. Do not display a reference value.
